actual: On 2026-09-04 run simrun_555075b03708358f, the LocalSIM mark loader correctly builds a frozen pre_close mark for suspended 002998.SZ with SUSPENDED_PREV_CLOSE provenance, but the scheduler misinterprets the mark valuation as_of_time as the source-effective date and rejects the current snapshot timestamp. The resulting LOCALSIM_SUSPENDED_PREV_CLOSE_UNPROVEN aborts the whole portfolio batch, leaving 89 healthy execution states at observed_until 09:30:51 with zero fills while TDX has current bars. The durable recovery path then reports recovery without advancing in the same tick, temporarily clearing runtime health without causal progress.

description: On 2026-09-04 run simrun_555075b03708358f, frozen daily context correctly marks 002998.SZ suspended and the LocalSIM loader builds the previous-close price with SUSPENDED_PREV_CLOSE provenance. The scheduler nevertheless rejects that valid mark because it conflates the current valuation as_of_time with the previous-close source-effective date. The whole portfolio batch aborts, leaving 89 healthy execution states at observed_until 09:30:51 with zero fills. Durable recovery also returns before attempting causal progress, creating alternating false-green recovery and FAILED_RETRYABLE ticks.
expected: A suspended position is valued at the frozen authoritative pre_close with SUSPENDED_PREV_CLOSE provenance at the current snapshot time, remains an explicit no-fill market state, and cannot block healthy symbols from advancing. A safe durable recovery must continue the same scheduler tick into the causal minute loop; it may clear the current-day blocker only after that continuation succeeds or reaches a legitimate waiting state.
